reference.freeze_order: Source families and aggregate facts inspected before draft threshold selection. Thresholds frozen before numerical scoring; not blinded or independent reference calibration.
reference.joint_claim: Marginal task fraction needs no cross-target covariance. No joint latent recovery, simultaneous probability, within-person noise, causal identity or transport claim follows.
reference.new_criteria_rationale: Glucose 0.05 mmol/L, device time 5 min/day, RT 5 ms, accuracy 1 percentage point, bilateral hippocampus 0.05 cm^3, ventricle 0.5 cm^3 are explicit round native-unit research resolutions, not clinical thresholds. Half/double sensitivity mandatory. Not selected to rank ANI or to imply physiological completeness.
reference.purpose: Fraction of a fixed ten-target pilot whose own-population marginal mean meets stated sampling-SE criteria; five distinct domains cannot compensate for one another.
reference.source_frame_policy: Source-specific population, exact operator and horizon retained in every canonical task. Comparisons concern ability to estimate respective native quantities at shared explicit tolerances, never treatment efficacy or a common-population biological effect.
reference.status: draft workload; not ratified AB1 or validated biological sufficiency

targets.label: Device algorithm estimated time at >=3 MET
Device algorithm estimated sedentary time <1.8 MET

reference.unmeasured_policy: Unreported target remains unknown, not absent; no renormalization. Documented acquisition with missing precision remains unknown.
reference.weighting: Two targets per domain, weight 1 each; no overall winner.
